text_block_list.text:
I'm jus' a spineless hack dat lost last
time...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
But that's not gonn' keep me down! I'm
gonn' get
up aft'r ev'ry fall!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Ze next race is in ze bag! Jus' you vatch!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Baffling amalgamation of accents aside,
she looks
determined to win.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
